en: Divided-back German postcard with two black‑and‑white views. The front shows a brick school building titled "Schule in der Georg Victoria-Strasse" with children standing outside, and a second view titled "Emmerbrücke" showing an arched bridge over a river in a rural landscape. The caption at bottom reads "Bad Pyrmont-Oesdorf." The reverse reads "Postkarte" and carries a green 5‑pfennig Deutsches Reich stamp canceled "PYRMONT" with date 22.7.08, address lines, and later archive stamps of "Museum Schloss Bad Pyrmont."
